questions.question: equipment has given ______ to various
questions.questionHtml: equipment has given ______ to various
questions.solution:
Correct option - 1

On looking at the above mentioned passage, we observe that it is based how use of technology has given birth to various types of pollution in our environment. Industrial waste, uses of technological devices, etc. had contributed in increasing pollution. 

The starter of the passage explains that it is because of uses of technological equipment that we use which has led various types of pollution. Word rise which means 'to get up; to become active' is an appropriate answer for the blank. Hence, option 1 i.e. rise is the correct answer.

Correct sentence - The use of technological equipment has given rise to various types of pollution.

questions.question: waste is ______ in the seas
questions.questionHtml: waste is ______ in the seas
questions.solution:
Correct option - 2

First of all, let's find out the meaning of given options :-

Crown - A headgear worn by a king and queen.

Thrown - To put in hurry; to cause to fall to the ground.

Drawn - To cause to move in a particular direction; to bring, take or pull out.

Moron - A stupid or foolish guy.

With reference to the context, word 'crown & moron' are not appropriate answers. Hence, options 1 & 4 are eliminated. Also, waste is not taken in a particular direction. Hence, option 3 is eliminated. So, option 2 i.e. thrown is the correct answer.

Correct sentence - waste is thrown in the seas.

questions.question: the smoke ______ by factories
questions.questionHtml: the smoke ______ by factories
questions.solution:
Correct option - 3

Firstly, there is no word like transmilted, hence, option 4 is clearly eliminated.

Let's find out the meaning of other given options :-

Remitted - To transfer or send (money, a check, etc.) to a person or place, usually in payment.

Admitted - Confessed; taken in approval of something.

Emitted - To produce heat, light, gas or a smell by means of physical or chemical process.

With reference to the context, the smoke which is produced by the factories and vehicle causes air pollution, etc.

Hence, word emitted is an appropriate answer. Thus, option 3 i.e. emitted is the correct answer.

Correct sentence - the smoke emitted by factories and vehicles causes air pollution, noise pollution is also a result of the production/ use of technological devices.

questions.question: waste has also ______ to soil
questions.questionHtml: waste has also ______ to soil
questions.solution:
Correct option - 4

First of all, helping verb used in the sentence is has which shows that the sentence is a perfect tense. Hence, verb's 3rd form should be followed here. Thus, the only appropriate word which best fits the blank is led. It means to bring forward, to increase. Hence, option 4 i.e. led is the correct answer.

Correct sentence -  Industrial waste has also led to soil pollution.

questions.question: Technological ______ has also given way to thermal
questions.questionHtml: Technological ______ has also given way to thermal
questions.solution:
Correct option - 3

First of all,there is no word like 'repairment'. Hence, option 1 is clearly eliminated.

Now, let's find out the meaning of other given options :-

Increment - Something added or gained; addiction.

Advancement - Act of moving forward; progress.

Regression - The act of going back to a previous place.

With reference to the context, progress in technology has made a way for thermal, radioactive and light pollution.So, option 4 i.e. advancement is the correct answer.

Correct sentence - Technological advancement has also given way to thermal, radioactive and light pollution.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
questions.questionHtml: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'phone.'

Key Points

  • The given passage is comparing the use of mobile phones with the use of landline phones.
  • The given sentence "The proportion of ___(1)___ users in India is said to be 90.1%.'' is indicating the use of mobile phones as the next sentence is talking about the decrease in the use of landline phones.
  • Therefore, the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is 'phone'.
  • The word 'phone' means a telephone that you can carry around with you. 
    • Example: A phone makes you contactable wherever you are.
       

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Complete Sentence: The proportion of phone users in India is said to be 90.1%.

Additional Information

  • Let us explore  the other options:
    • 'Landline' is the phone connection that comes into a particular building using cables. (फ़ोन कनेक्शन जो केबल का उपयोग करके किसी विशेष भवन में आता है)
    • 'Text' means to send somebody a written message using a mobile phone. (मोबाइल फ़ोन या चल भाष पर लिखित संदेश भेजना)
    • 'Computer' is an electronic machine that can store, find and arrange information, calculate amounts and control other machines. (जानकारी संचित करने, ढूँढ़ने व व्‍यवस्थित करने, परिकलन करने व अन्‍य मशीनों पर नियंत्रण रख पाने वाली एक इलेक्‍ट्रॉनिक मशीन; कंप्‍यूटर)
       

Hinglish

  • दिया गया अनुच्छेद मोबाइल फोन के उपयोग की तुलना लैंडलाइन फोन के उपयोग से कर रहा है।
  • दिया गया वाक्य "The proportion of ___(1)___ users in India is said to be 90.1%.'' मोबाइल फोन के उपयोग का संकेत दे रहा है क्योंकि अगला वाक्य लैंडलाइन फोन के उपयोग में कमी के बारे में बात कर रहा है।
  • इसलिए, रिक्त स्थान में भरने के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त शब्द 'phone' है।
  • 'Phone' शब्द का अर्थ है एक प्रकार का टेलीफ़ोन जिसे चलते फिरते आप अपने साथ रख सकते हैं; चल भाष, मोबाइल फ़ोन।
    • उदाहरण: A phone makes you contactable wherever you are.


अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 है।

पूर्ण वाक्य: The proportion of phone users in India is said to be 90.1%.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
questions.questionHtml: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'number.'

Key Points

  • The given passage is comparing the use of mobile phones with the use of landline phones.
  • The given sentence "While the use of landline phones continues to decline, the ___(2)___ of mobile phone users appears to have reached a plateau, according to reports.'' is indicating the decrease in the use of landline phones and increase in the use of mobile phones by people.
  • Therefore, the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is 'number'.
  • The word 'number' means a quantity of people or things. 
    • Example: A growing number of people are going vegetarian.
       

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Complete Sentence: While the use of landline phones continues to decline, the number of mobile phone users appears to have reached a plateau, according to reports.

Mistake Points

  • Ratio and proportion cannot be used because they are used when we compare two quantities. Here, the sentence is only talking about the number of mobile phone users.
  • Thus, 'number' is the correct answer.
     

Additional Information

  • Let us explore  the other options:
    • 'Ratio' means the relationship between two numbers which shows how much bigger one quantity is than another. (अनुपात, दो संख्‍याओं के बीच संबंध जो बताता है कि एक संख्‍या दूसरी से कितनी बड़ी है)
    • 'Proportion' means the relationship between the size or amount of two things. (आकार या मात्रा की दृष्टि से एक वस्‍तु का दूसरी वस्‍तु से संबंध; अनुपात)
    • 'Figure' means an amount in numbers or a price. (राशि संख्‍या में या मूल्‍य)
       

Hinglish

  • दिया गया अनुच्छेद मोबाइल फोन के उपयोग की तुलना लैंडलाइन फोन के उपयोग से कर रहा है।
  • दिया गया वाक्य "While the use of landline phones continues to decline, the ___(2)___ of mobile phone users appears to have reached a plateau, according to reports.'' लोगों द्वारा लैंडलाइन फोन के उपयोग में कमी और मोबाइल फोन के उपयोग में वृद्धि का संकेत दे रहा है।
  • इसलिए, रिक्त स्थान में भरने के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त शब्द 'number' है।
  • 'Number' शब्द का अर्थ है व्‍यक्तियों या वस्‍तुओं की संख्‍या।
    • उदाहरण:  A growing number of people are going vegetarian.


अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 है।

पूर्ण वाक्य: While the use of landline phones continues to decline, the number of mobile phone users appears to have reached a plateau, according to reports.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
questions.questionHtml: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'subscribers.'

Key Points

  • The given passage is comparing the use of mobile phones with the use of landline phones.
  • The given sentence "The number of ___(3)___ to landline phones had gone up from 9.8 million in 1995 to 21.7 million in 2019.'' is indicating the increase in the use of landlines from 1995 to 2019.
  • Therefore, the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is 'subscribers'.
  • The word 'subscribers' means people who pay to use a particular service. 
    • Example: China has almost 15 million subscribers to satellite and cable television.
  • ​Also, the preposition 'to' is used with the verb 'subscribe.'
  • Subscribe to something means to agree with or support an opinion, belief, or theory.
    • For Example - Frank subscribed firmly to the belief that human kindness would overcome evil.
       

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Complete Sentence: The number of subscribers to landline phones had gone up from 9.8 million in 1995 to 21.7 million in 2019.

Additional Information

  • Let us explore  the other options:
    • 'Sellers' means people or business that sells. (विक्रेता)
    • 'Producers' means people, company or country that makes or grow something. (किसी वस्‍तु का निर्माता या उत्‍पादक)
    • 'Buyers' means people who buy something or may buy something. (ख़रीदार)
       

Hinglish

  • दिया गया अनुच्छेद मोबाइल फोन के उपयोग की तुलना लैंडलाइन फोन के उपयोग से कर रहा है।
  • दिया गया वाक्य "The number of ___(3)___ to landline phones had gone up from 9.8 million in 1995 to 21.7 million in 2019.'' 1995 से 2019 तक लोगों द्वारा लैंडलाइन के उपयोग में वृद्धि का संकेत दे रहा है।
  • इसलिए, रिक्त स्थान में भरने के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त शब्द 'subscribers' है।
  • 'Subscribers' शब्द का अर्थ है किसी सेवा का नियमित ग्राहक।
    • उदाहरण: China has almost 15 million subscribers to satellite and cable television.
  • साथ ही, पूर्वसर्ग 'to' का प्रयोग 'subscribe' क्रिया के साथ किया जाता है।
  • Subscribe to something का अर्थ है किसी चीज़ की सदस्यता लेना।
    • उदाहरण के लिए -  Frank subscribed firmly to the belief that human kindness would overcome evil.


अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 है।

पूर्ण वाक्य: The number of subscribers to landline phones had gone up from 9.8 million in 1995 to 21.7 million in 2019.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
questions.questionHtml: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'astonishing.'

Key Points

  • The given passage is comparing the use of mobile phones with the use of landline phones.
  • The given sentence "On the other hand, India had only 1.2 million cell phone users in 1999, which grew to an ___(4)___ figure of 1,161.7 million in 2019.'' is indicating the surprising growth of cell phone users.
  • Therefore, the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is 'astonishing'.
  • The word 'astonishing' means very surprising. 
    • Example: The new houses have been built with astonishing speed.
       

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Complete Sentence: On the other hand, India had only 1.2 million cell phone users in 1999, which grew to an astonishing figure of 1,161.7 million in 2019.

Additional Information

  • Let us explore  the other options:
    • 'Anticipated' means to expect something to happen and prepare for it. (कुछ घटित होने की प्रत्‍याशा करना और उसके लिए तैयार रहना)
    • 'Excellent' means very good; of high quality. (बहुत बढ़िया; उच्‍च स्‍तर का, उत्‍कृष्‍ट)
    • 'Imaginable' means something that you can imagine. (जिसकी कल्‍पना की जा सके; कल्‍पनीय, चिंतनीय)
       

Hinglish

  • दिया गया अनुच्छेद मोबाइल फोन के उपयोग की तुलना लैंडलाइन फोन के उपयोग से कर रहा है।
  • दिया गया वाक्य "The number of ___(3)___ to landline phones had gone up from 9.8 million in 1995 to 21.7 million in 2019.'' सेल फोन उपयोगकर्ताओं की आश्चर्यजनक वृद्धि का संकेत दे रहा है।
  • इसलिए, रिक्त स्थान में भरने के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त शब्द 'astonishing' है।
  • 'Astonishing' शब्द का अर्थ है आश्‍चर्यजनक, विस्‍मयकारी।
    • उदाहरण: The new houses have been built with astonishing speed.


अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 है।

पूर्ण वाक्य: On the other hand, India had only 1.2 million cell phone users in 1999, which grew to an astonishing figure of 1,161.7 million in 2019.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
questions.questionHtml: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'thrown out.'

Key Points

  • The given passage is comparing the use of mobile phones with the use of landline phones.
  • The given sentence "Mobile phones have also literally ___(5)___ phone booths.'' is indicating what happened with the phone booths due to increased mobile phone users.
  • Therefore, the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is 'thrown out.'
  • The word 'thrown out' means to get rid of as worthless or unnecessary.  
    • Example: The case was thrown out of court because of insufficient evidence.
       

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Complete Sentence: Mobile phones have also literally thrown out phone booths.

Additional Information

  • Let us explore  the other options:
    • 'Destroyed' means to damage something so badly that it can no longer be used or no longer exists. (किसी वस्‍तु को इस तरह हानि पहुँचाना कि वह इस्‍तेमाल न हो सके या समाप्‍त हो जाए, नष्‍ट करना)
    • 'Established' means to become accepted and recognized as something. (किसी विशेष रूप में मान्‍य होना; प्रतिष्ठित होना)
    • 'Erased' means to remove something completely. (पूरी तरह मिटा देना)
       

Hinglish

  • दिया गया अनुच्छेद मोबाइल फोन के उपयोग की तुलना लैंडलाइन फोन के उपयोग से कर रहा है।
  • दिया गया वाक्य "Mobile phones have also literally ___(5)___ phone booths.'' यह इंगित कर रहा है कि मोबाइल फोन उपयोगकर्ताओं में वृद्धि के कारण फोन बूथों के साथ क्या हुआ।
  • इसलिए, रिक्त स्थान में भरने के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त शब्द 'thrown out' है।
  • 'Thrown out' शब्द का अर्थ है बेकार या अनावश्यक के रूप में छुटकारा पाना।
    • उदाहरण: The case was thrown out of court because of insufficient evidence.


अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 है।

पूर्ण वाक्य: Mobile phones have also literally thrown out phone booths.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
questions.questionHtml: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Composed'

Key Points

  • Seychelles, one of the world’s smallest countries, is (1) ______ of two main island groups:
  • Let's see the meaning of the given words-
    • ​Composed- constitute or makeup (a whole, or a specified part of it).
    • Contained- have or hold (someone or something) within.
    • Covered- put something on top of or in front of (something), especially in order to protect or conceal it.
    • Combined- join or merge to form a single unit or substance.
  • According to the sentence, we need to use a word that means makeup because 'Seychelles' is made up of small islands. 

Hence, the correct sentence is- Seychelles, one of the world’s smallest countries, is composed of two main island groups:

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
questions.questionHtml: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'More'

Key Points

  • the Mahé group of (2) ______ than 40 central, mountainous granitic islands

  • Hence, the correct answer is Option 2 i.e. More.

So the correct sentence is- the Mahé group of more than 40 central, mountainous granitic islands

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.

The correct answer is 'Second'

  • and a (3) ______ group of more than 70 outer, flat, coralline islands.

  • So the correct answer is Option 4 i.e. Second.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
questions.questionHtml: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Typically'

Key Points

  • The islands of the Mahé group are rocky and (4) ______ have a narrow coastal strip and a central range of hills.
  • Let's see the meanings of the given words-
    • Regularly- with a constant or definite pattern, especially with the same space between individual items.
    • Typically- in most cases; usually.
    • Routinely- as part of a regular procedure rather than for a special reason.
    • Habitually- by way of habit; customarily.
  • Hence, according to the meanings of the given words, the correct answer is Option 2 i.e. Typically.

So the correct sentence is- The islands of the Mahé group are rocky and typically have a narrow coastal strip and a central range of hills.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
questions.questionHtml: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'predominant'

Key Points

  • The (5) ______ feature of those islands, with their lush tropical vegetation, is that of high-hanging gardens overlooking silver-white beaches and clear lagoons.
  • Let's see the meanings of the given words-
    • Collective- done by people acting as a group.
    • Predominant- present as the strongest or main element.
    • Global- relating to the whole world; worldwide.
    • Wide- of great or more than average width.
  • Hence, the correct answer is Option 2 i.e. Predominant.
  • The sentence is talking about the strongest feature of the islands

Hence, the correct sentence is- The predominant feature of those islands, with their lush tropical vegetation, is that of high-hanging gardens overlooking silver-white beaches and clear lagoons.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.1.
questions.questionHtml: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.1.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'reduced'.

Key Points

  • The most appropriate word for the given blank is 'reduced'.
  • It means 'to make something less or smaller in quantity, price, size, etc.' (मात्रा, क़ीमत, आकार आदि की दृष्टि से घटाना; छोटा करना)
    • Example: The sign said ‘Reduce speed now’.
  • Thus, the correct answer is Option 4.
     

Correct Passage: New cycle routes have been built in and around the centre of Birmingham and speed limits have been reduced on selected roads. The scheme has now been in (2) ______ for a year and has been hailed as a (3) ______ success. Since the new speed limits were (4) ______, the number of accidents in the area have fallen (5) ______.

Additional Information 

  • Let's look at the meaning of other words
    • ​shortened: to become shorter or to make something shorter. (छोटा हो जाना या कर देना
    • lessened: to become less; to make something less. (कम हो जाना; कम कर देना
    • scaled: to climb up a high wall, steep cliff, etc. (ऊँची दीवार या खड़ी चट्टान आदि पर चढ़ना)

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.2.
questions.questionHtml: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.2.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'operation'.

Key Points

  • The most appropriate word for the given blank is 'operation'.
  • It means 'the fact of operating or being active (संचालन या सक्रिय होने का तथ्य)'.
    • Example: There are several reactors of the type in operation (= working) at the moment.

The complete passage is- In the 19th century, there was an industrial revolution in Europe. As a result, millions of people left the (1) countryside and went to work in big factories in cities. Besides, modern transport and communications have made it easier for people to (4) commute to work or even work from home. The result of this revolution in the 21st century will be ‘spread cities’ - cities are growing fast, but (5) outwards, away from city centres and people are choosing to live 40, 50 or 60 kilometres away.

  • Instead is an adverb. It means ‘as an alternative’.
    • Example: He didn’t buy a large loaf. Instead, he bought two small loaves.
  • An adverb 'instead' goes at the beginning or at the end of a clause.
  • In the given passage, it is clear that jobs are few in heavy industries while there are more jobs in service industries.
  • Therefore, the most appropriate option to be filled in blank 3 is 'instead'.
  • Hence, option 2 is the correct answer.

 

The complete passage is- In the 19th century, there was an industrial revolution in Europe. As a result, millions of people left the (1) countryside and went to work in big factories in cities. Today, it is the reverse. In several major cities, people have started moving out. Why? They want a cleaner, (2) greener environment. There are fewer jobs in ‘heavy’ industries like steel and power generation. (3) Instead, there are more jobs in service industries like banking, tourism, and food delivery. Besides, modern transport and communications have made it easier for people to (4) commute to work or even work from home. The result of this revolution in the 21st century will be ‘spread cities’ - cities are growing fast, but (5) outwards, away from city centres and people are choosing to live 40, 50 or 60 kilometres away.

Additional InformationLet's learn the usage of other given options:

  • We say 'of course' to suggest that something is normal, obvious, or well-known, and should therefore not surprise the person you are talking to.
    • Example: Of course there were lots of other interesting things at the exhibition.
  • We use 'nevertheless' when saying something that contrasts with what has just been said.
    • Example: His father, though ill-equipped for the project, had nevertheless tried his best.
  • 'Clearly' means in a clear manner.
    • Example: You should try to speak more clearly.

    • उदाहरण: He didn’t buy a large loaf. Instead, he bought two small loaves.
  • एक adverb के रूप में instead शुरुआत में या किसी clause के अंत में जाता है।
  • दिए गए passage में, यह स्पष्ट है कि heavy industries में नौकरियां कम हैं जबकि सेवा उद्योगों में अधिक नौकरियां हैं।
  • अतः रिक्त 3 की पूर्ति के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प 'instead' है।
  • अतः विकल्प 2 सही उत्तर है।
  • 'of course' का अर्थ है 'बेशक'।
    • उदाहरण:  Of course there were lots of other interesting things at the exhibition.
  • 'Nevertheless' का अर्थ है 'फिर भी'।
    • उदाहरण: His father, though ill-equipped for the project, had nevertheless tried his best.
  • 'Clearly' का अर्थ 'स्पष्ट तरीके से' है।
    • उदाहरण: You should try to speak more clearly.
